Okay, I thought they were actually going to talk about Daybreak, not just tease us horribly with pictures. D:

Like, Rockstar looks neat, I want to know what she does. Muerto's got the kind of design that I just have to know more about, there is some kind of crazy story going on there. And Muse -- who I have to keep reminding myself is the Dreamer, and thus technically Visionary -- is definitely making a fashion statement, shall we say. c.c Scary.

BUT AEON GIRL IS SO CUTE @_@ I was not prepared for this, I can't handle it.

Yet even moreso, between his look and his pose, Headlong makes me go "This dude is so freaking cool." Like, he could do anything with that kind of name, but... dang, I can't even explain, I gotta know!

And I guess Young Legacy is cool or something, too. :B
